source_title: What Is A Regulatory Operating Fee

snippets.snippet_text: "Sellers in certain countries are charged a small Regulatory Operating fee in addition to current selling costs. This fee is charged on the item price and shipping costs (including gift wrap and personalization costs, if applicable) and will vary based on seller location."
